name: Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate
description: A Munificent-class star frigate was created at the Gwori shipyards during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano stole the frigate to help them transport the slave workers in the shipyards off-world during a battle on Gwori.

data.name: Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate
data.armament: None (armaments were not yet fitted when the ship was stolen)
